description: Supplementary Data for: Integrated multi-hazard climate risk across Egypt's water–coast–delta system — reservoir evaporation, coastal inundation, and socio-economic vulnerability (reproducibility arch is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Reproducibility archive for the manuscript "Integrated multi-hazard climate risk across Egypt's water–coast–delta system: reservoir evaporation, coastal inundation, and socio-economic vulnerability" (submitted to Scientific Reports). Coverage: Egypt. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are climate change; Egypt; Lake Nasser; evaporation; sea-level rise; Nile Delta; coastal inundation; multi-hazard risk; CMIP6; adaptation; vulnerability.. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
